post.summary: Create an item. A title (and the space) is enough

title.description: The only required field besides the space

parent_id.description: Omit or null for a root item

column_id.description: Default: the first column of the requested state

state.description: Default "unstarted". Must match the column when both are given

lead_id.description: An actor who is a member of the space

expected_version.description: The `version` you started from. Required with title, description, type or lead_id; a mismatch is a 409

post.summary: Change parent, column and place among the siblings in one step

column_id.description: The new column (the item takes its state); omit to keep the column
